clauses.reason: Terminated by own terms: 'until November 1, 1935' (stated date inclusive, 1935-11-01; exclusive reading one day earlier). Actor EO:6773 itself. Later events: new 'further exemption' grants of the same person, each with its own date and quote; none revokes or amends this order.

research_rationale:
EO:6773 (1934-06-30) is a single-clause order under section 204 of the Economy Act of June 30, 1932 exempting Carleton W. Sturtevant from compulsory retirement for age and continuing the person in the service 'until November 1, 1935'. The order ends by its own terms on 1935-11-01 (stated date, inclusive; exclusive alternative one day earlier, per the owner's 2026-10-21 ruling on 'until' dates). Later orders in the same person's exemption chain, read in the packet: EO:7217 (1935-10-30); each is recorded as a later event with its own date and quote (owner ruling, 2026-10-21), and none revokes, amends or shortens this order. The machine term lead dated 1934-01-24 is the recited birthday ('who was 70 years of age on January 24, 1934'), not an end; the operative until-date governs. The dossier's machine term leads were read against the text; the operative until-date in the command sentence is the end. @rationale:retirement:statute @rationale:retirement:search @rationale:retirement:inventory

A later 'further' exemption of the same person is a new grant under the statute, not a savings clause of this order, and the person's employment after the stated date rests on that later order, not on this one.
